backends.label: pinocchio
backends.name: pinocchio
settings: rigid rollouts: semi-implicit Euler on ABA with the shared timestep (no limits)

defaults.base: fixed unless a root joint (e.g. JointModelFreeFlyer) is passed
defaults.missing <inertial>: zero mass and inertia (the URDF specification)
defaults.mimic: independent joint unless built with mimic=True

problems.headline: An engine refused to load the model
hints: MuJoCo rejects physically impossible inertia tensors (A + B >= C, positive eigenvalues), even on static links, while other engines accept them silently. Fix the tensor, or try `-b mujoco:balanceinertia=true`.

problems.headline: Engines simulate different mass, center of mass or inertia than the file declares
hints: These bodies include links without <inertial>, for which each engine substitutes its own default mass (the links are listed under file.inertial). Add explicit <inertial> blocks.

These bodies include links whose inertia tensor is not physical, or on the edge of it (listed under file.inertia_validity); MuJoCo refuses such tensors, PyBullet sets them to zero, Pinocchio keeps them. Fix the tensors.
PyBullet's loadURDF ignores URDF inertia tensors by default and recomputes them from collision shapes. Pass flags=URDF_USE_INERTIA_FROM_FILE (simcompat: -b pybullet:inertia_from_file=1).

problems.headline: Some inertia tensors are impossible or degenerate, and engines refuse, zero or keep them
hints: MuJoCo refuses such tensors, PyBullet sets them to zero, Pinocchio keeps them. Fix the tensor.

problems.headline: Moving links have no <inertial>, so each engine invents its own mass for them
hints: Add an explicit <inertial> so every engine uses the same mass.

problems.headline: Engines number the joints differently
hints: Map joints by name, never by index, when moving a policy between engines.
